ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark charcoal) pixels with localized high-intensity (white) clusters; estimated white-to-black pixel ratio is 0.15:0.85.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base pigmentation with numerous high-contrast white ring-shaped blobs (rosettes) scattered across the entire visible surface. High-intensity white clusters are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of roughly 0.4.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the superior boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 4 and 18 pixels against the background sky/water interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge trajectory sweeping sharply upwards and outwards toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular and annular high-contrast white pixel clusters across both lobes, consistent with old barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization (dense white/textured pixel masses) present on the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
